note: City of Stanley campground on a small peninsula in Chapman Lake, with a campground host on site; swimming and ballfields are nearby in the park. Stays of two weeks or more must leave room for mowing. --Claude
summary: City page read: 29 sites (25 with 30A electric, site 23 tent-only), shower house, flush toilets, dump, $35/night (also weekly and monthly), May 1 - Oct 31, reservations by phone to City Hall. All sites are sold by the night; there are no seasonal leases. Google 4.4 (47). Lakefront confirmed on imagery.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakefront confirmed. The loop occupies a peninsula. On the south side the pads sit on open mown grass 15-30 m from the water, with an RV visible on a pad at about 44.96561,-90.94281. The north side is 25-35 m from a weedy shore with a few trees. The city says 'all within steps of the lake'. It posts no site map, so I can't give site numbers. All sites are sold by the night.
SITES: count 30 -> 29 (city: '29 Sites'); 25 of them electric, not 'about 30'.
SEASON: new, 05-01..10-31 (city page); same in 2027 by its wording.
LOCAL: run by the City of Stanley. Nightly share 100%: nightly, weekly, two-week and monthly rates and no seasonal leases. Google Maps 4.4 stars, 47 reviews ('Chapman Lake Campgrounds(Showers)').
PHONE: empty -> 715-644-5758 (City Hall, the reservation line).
WEBSITE: https://www.ci.stanley.wi.gov/streets is current (200) and holds the campground section. No change.
PIN: 44.96616,-90.94310 is in the middle of the campground loop. Fine.
HORSES: the city notes 'Chapman Park currently does not have Horse Camping facilities available' -> no horse issue.
